newsitem.title: COMOROS: Comoros hands out third death sentence in week.
newsitem.headline: Comoros hands out third death sentence in week.

text.p: A court in the Comoros has imposed the third death sentence in a week as part of a crackdown on crime in the Indian Ocean islands.
The assize court in the capital Moroni, surrounded by a crowd listening to the proceedings from loudspeakers, sentenced Mohamed Yousouff, 30, to death on Saturday for murder.
President Mohamed Taki has ordered that all murderers be sentenced to death to stem a crime wave.

Yousouff's lawyer told the court he had killed Mvoulana Hamadi at the instigation of Yousouff's uncle Maoulida Ali -- who had escaped from prison. But the court decided this did not mitigate his guilt.
There is no appeal against the assize court sentence, but the president has the power to pardon those sentenced to death.
Legal sources said there was little prospect of a pardon, and the sentence was likely to be carried out by firing squad.
